Sanjana Qureshi
Senior Finance Professional | Ahmedabad, Gujarat
sanjana.qureshi372@example.com | +91 9582548950

Detail-oriented finance professional with strong operational accounting experience across corporate and consulting environments. Skilled at closing month-end processes, implementing compliance controls, and supporting ERP-driven financial operations. Proven ability to streamline accounts payable workflows and deliver accurate reporting under tight deadlines. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience
Ledgerly — Jan 2026 - Present
Accountant (On-site)
- Led month-end close for vendor and ledger reconciliations, resolving discrepancies and reducing outstanding Accounts Payable aging >90 days by 55% through process changes and stricter invoice controls using GST-compliant workflows.
- Prepared IFRS-aligned journal entries and supporting schedules for quarterly reporting, decreasing audit adjustments by 30% year-over-year.
- Managed GST filings and vendor GST verification, ensuring timely returns and avoiding penalties; implemented checklist that cut filing errors by 40%.
- Streamlined invoice processing and payment runs for Accounts Payable, improving on-time payments from 72% to 92% and optimizing cash flow timing.

Bluefin Logistics — Jul 2025 - Dec 2025
Finance Executive (Hybrid)
- Built Financial Modeling templates to forecast monthly cash requirements and working capital, enabling management to reduce short-term borrowing by 18%.
- Performed reconciliations and bookkeeping in Tally for multiple branches, standardizing chart of accounts and reducing reconciliation time by 25%.
- Administered TDS calculations and quarterly TDS filings, ensuring 100% compliance and accurate deposits; implemented audit-ready documentation standards.
- Supported SAP FICO integration by validating master data and testing posted transactions, identifying and correcting mapping issues prior to go-live.

Cognizant — Dec 2021 - Jun 2025
Finance Executive (Remote)
- Processed high-volume transactional accounting in SAP FICO, maintaining accuracy for invoicing and ledger postings and reducing reconciliation exceptions by 28%.
- Managed statutory compliance including TDS processing and submission across client accounts, improving timeliness and reducing late-payment penalties.
- Reconciled accounts and prepared IFRS-conforming schedules for consolidation packs, contributing to timely month-end closes.
- Maintained bookkeeping and operational entries in Tally for supporting client engagements, improving transparency and traceability of transactions.

Projects
- AP Automation Pilot: Led a pilot using Confluence to document AP workflows and coordinate cross-functional testing; pilot reduced approval cycle time by 35%.
- Linux-based Reporting Automation: Implemented simple shell scripts on Linux to automate file consolidation and feed data into Financial Modeling templates, cutting manual prep time by 20%.

Skills
Accounting Tools: Tally, SAP FICO
Tax & Compliance: GST, TDS, IFRS
Finance & Analysis: Accounts Payable, Financial Modeling
Collaboration & Tech: Confluence, Linux, Agile

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
